responses.title: TTL / Capacity View
responses.summary: Under governed, evidence-only conditions, the TTL snapshot covers 45 governed entities, each with a months-to-live estimate from the supply/demand intersection method. Months-to-live ranges from 5.23 to 73.84 months, with a median of 18.60. By status, 33 entities are Cool, 10 are Healthy and 2 are in Warning. Importantly, demand is the real forecast but supply and the resulting TTL are simulated under a flat-supply assumption, so TTL is a planning signal, not a commitment.
